steps.en: Install the adapter for your framework
Declare exactly the features this table uses
steps.zh: 声明这张表要用的全部功能

steps.en: Define columns and data, then create the table in your component
steps.zh: 定义列和数据，在组件里创建表格实例

steps.en: Tracks sorting, filtering, pagination and selection state and computes the rows that should be visible
steps.zh: 记账排序、过滤、分页与选行状态，算出该显示哪些行

steps.en: Render its header groups, rows and cells as your own markup
steps.zh: 把它的表头组、行、单元格渲染成你自己的标签

steps.en: A header click flips the sort order; only the affected row models recompute
steps.zh: 点击表头即切换排序，只有受影响的部分重算

value.en: A fully interactive datagrid without hand-writing sorting/filtering/pagination state logic — markup, CSS and design system stay 100% yours
value.zh: 不手写排序／过滤／分页的状态逻辑就有可交互表格——标签、样式、设计系统 100% 归你
